defs.meaning: 贿赂；奖金，离职补偿金；（投资）利润，（赌博）赚头；结果

examples.en: It would take him the rest of his life to pay off that loan.
examples.zh: 还清那笔贷款将花费他的余生。

examples.en: The firm will be able to pay off its debts and still turn a modest profit.
examples.zh: 该公司将能够还清其债务，而且还会稍有赢利。

examples.en: I need to pay off all my debts before I leave the country.
examples.zh: 我得在离开该国前偿清所有债务。
